subject: tupleHeaderVsCall
why: E5b1 `s[0], x = m(), 3` (s captured, m rebinding it [1, 2] → [7, 8, 9] and returning 5): the element target is a FROZEN plan — its header read is spec-unsequenced against m, so the store lands in the old array (57) or the new one (15); the ONE consumption site is the `unseq` scheduler's pick (`unseqNext`, bound = the ready-set size at each pick; Stage E5 E5b, 2026-09-22 — design docs/2026-09-22_unseq-stage-e5-design.md §E5b). members=2

subject: blankPanicVsCall
expected_reason: index out of range [9] with length 1
why: E5b2 `_, x = a[9], wit(1)` (a = [1]): the blank target's checked read panics; wit is the sibling event, spec-unsequenced against it — the panic alone, or `wit 1` then the panic (gc's, call-first); the ONE consumption site is the `unseq` scheduler's pick (`unseqNext`; Stage E5 E5b — design §E5b). members=2

subject: commaOkRecvTargetVsPanic
expected_reason: index out of range [9] with length 1
why: E5b3 `xs[a[9]], ok = <-ch` (ch holding 3; a = [1]): the planned target's index read panics before the comma-ok receive (the deferred witness prints len 1) or after it (len 0 — gc's, the receive first); the ONE consumption site is the `unseq` scheduler's pick (`unseqNext`; Stage E5 E5b — design §E5b). members=2

subject: multiCallHeaderVsCall
why: E5b4 `x, s[0] = twoRebind()` (the call rebinds the captured s and returns (1, 5)): the element target's frozen header before or after the call — 57 or 15 (gc's: the call first); the ONE consumption site is the `unseq` scheduler's pick (`unseqNext`; Stage E5 E5b — design §E5b). members=2

subject: defineTupleVsCall
why: `x, y := m(), s[0]` (s captured, m: s[0] = 10, returns 5): the checked read of s[0] is spec-unsequenced against m — before m 6, after 15 (gc's); the declares ride the completion; the ONE consumption site is the `unseq` scheduler's pick (`unseqNext`; Stage E5 E5b — design §E5b). members=2
